model_annotation: The two line graphs display the relationship between the variable BLEU and two different parameters, α and ρ, respectively. Both graphs share a common y-axis labeled "BLEU," which ranges from 28.0 to 28.5 in increments of 0.1, representing a linear scale. The left graph plots BLEU against α, which is shown on a linear x-axis ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 with labeled tick marks at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9. The data points, marked with blue circles, are connected by a solid blue line, showing a peak BLEU value of 28.5 at α = 0.5, with values of 28.0 at α = 0.1, 28.3 at α = 0.3, 28.4 at α = 0.7, and 28.1 at α = 0.9. The right graph plots BLEU against ρ, with a linear x-axis ranging from 0.05 to 0.45, marked at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45. The data points, also marked with blue circles and connected by a solid blue line, show a peak BLEU value of 28.5 at ρ = 0.15, with values of 28.3 at ρ = 0.05, 28.4 at ρ = 0.25, 28.4 at ρ = 0.35, and 28.4 at ρ = 0.45.
